newsitem.title: USA: Access Health up after gaining contract.
newsitem.headline: Access Health up after gaining contract.

text.p: Shares in Access Health Inc rose on Monday after the company was awarded a contract for personal health management services from the Federal Employees Program of the Blue Cross Blue Shield Association.
"It's a very good confirmation of their business model and their product," Equitable Securities Corp analyst Seth Frank said of the contract.

Frank upgraded Access Health Inc to strong buy from attractive long-term, citing the contract and the stock's price. He set a six-to-nine month price target of $48 on the shares, which were up 2-5/8 to 36-1/8 in afternoon trading.
Rancho Cordova, Calif.-based Access Health said Friday that it was awarded the contract beginning in 1997 to provide the personal health management services on a pilot basis in selected locations.
The contract may be extended to cover enrollees in the Federal Employees Program on a nationwide basis, the company said. It gave no further details.
